the mono and diamidine compounds inhibit respiratory syncytial viral fusion and penetration in a dose dependent manner.

the development of novel inhibitors of respiratory syncytium virus host cell interactions.
the development of novel compounds that inhibit the fusion process of respiratory syncytials virus with host cells.
the development of new compounds that inhibit respiratory syncytial viral infection of cultured cells.

the compounds tested are effective inhibitors of respiratory syncytials virus induced cell fusion and penetration.
amidine compounds inhibit respiratory syncytial fusion and penetration.
the amidines inhibit respiratory syncytial fusion and penetration, but do not interfere with single cycle replication.

the compounds that inhibit syncytium formation are also those that inhibit the proteases.

the diamidine compounds are effective inhibitors of fusion and penetration by respiratory syncytia virus and may have therapeutic potential for treating respiratory syncytial viral infections.
